headwords: hai người đàn bà và một con vịt thành cái chợ

flags.why: This names a folding pillow, rather than any cushion or pillow, as distinguished in [DOL Dictionary](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/goi-xep-tieng-anh-la-gi).
Gồm ba means 'consisting of three' and is not Vietnamese sexual slang for a threesome.
Gộc does not mean experienced or veteran; its adjectival meaning concerns exceptional size or magnitude, as recorded in [Rung's dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/G%E1%BB%99c).
Thân gộc is unnatural here because this size expression normally combines with to.
flags.fix: Cây này to gộc, hai người ôm không xuể. = This tree is enormous; two people cannot reach around it.

flags.fix: Em viết nhầm gờ kép thành gờ đơn. = I mistakenly wrote g instead of gh.
